messages:
clara: throwing out an idea from today's handoff — 'handoff contracts' for immediate post-incident ownership. 1-paragraph agreement in-thread that IC + owner acknowledge. small, timeboxed, enforceable :memo:
mohit: curious — how's this practically different from assign + ETA?
clara: assign+ETA often drifts. contract = owner, concrete deliverable, SLO (e.g., rollback/mitigation/patch), acceptance-window (hours), and explicit escalation if owner doesn't accept. makes the handoff contractual, not aspirational
isabel: can you paste a tiny contract we can copy into threads?
clara: sure, pasteable block:
```
HANDOFF-CONTRACT
- IC: @ic
- Owner: @owner (must ACCEPT or REJECT within 2h)
- Deliverable: one-sentence (what will be changed/done)
- SLO: e.g. mitigation within 24h, patch in 7d
- ETA: YYYY-MM-DD
- Rollout plan: quick bullet if deploys involved
- Recurrence-check: match fingerprint? yes/no
- Escalation: if no ACCEPT -> escalate to squad lead -> remediation council
```
ben: nice. add a tiny QA gate field: "QA smoke: yes/no" so owners remember to validate before closing
mohit: how do we get buy-in from owners during busy oncall windows? requiring immediate accept might be heavy
clara: acceptance-window can be tuned (2h default). IC can mark "interim-owner" if primary can't accept in-window; interim owns until primary accepts. this avoids dangling tasks during rotations
isabel: operationally, inc-bot could post the contract as a board-card draft and wait for ACCEPT. if accepted, card becomes active with owner and SLO tags
ops-bot: I can: create a contract-card draft, add an "ACCEPT/REJECT" button, start a timer set to the acceptance-window, and auto-escalate on timeout. integration requires board API keys (eng-sre)
ben: add recurrence automation: if contract's recurrence-check = yes and there are >=2 similar incidents in 60d, auto-tag "pattern" and open a pattern-review ticket
mohit: metrics we should track: contract-acceptance-time, percent-accepted-within-window, time-to-first-owner-update, percent-closed-within-SLO
clara: low-friction comms snippet for stakeholders when contract is created:
"Contracted: owner @owner, deliverable: <one-line>, ETA: <date>, SLO: <xx>. Will update at next check-in."
isabel: small UX thing: encourage owners to add "next-check" timestamp so the contract generates automatic reminders (inc-bot pings)
ops-bot: noting: I can ping @owner at the next-check and at SLO boundaries. Recommend default next-check = +48h for mitigation SLOs <72h
ben: implementation idea: treat contracts as a short-lived contract-card type on the remediation board with expiry metadata so the weekly backlog sweep can ignore them unless escalated
mohit: one risk: overuse for trivial stuff. propose a quick heuristic: contracts for Sev2+ or any action with cross-squad impact or >1h estimated work
clara: agreed. we'll add that guardrail to the KB
isabel: next steps: 1) KB: add contract template + heuristics (clara) 2) postmortem template: include contract section and checkbox (isabel) 3) ops-bot: prototype accept/timeout flow and card draft (ops-bot) 4) pilot on next 10 Sev2+ incidents for 2 weeks (ben will measure metrics)
ben: taking pilot metrics and pattern classifier prototype. will report in 2 weeks
ops-bot: will prototype accept/timeout flow, ETA 5 days pending board API keys approval
clara: I'll update KB tonight and add example contracts. if pilot looks good we can fold into IC checklist as required for matching incidents
mohit: fine-grained change but should reduce ownership drift and make recurring patterns actionable earlier :seedling:
